_note: Expanded benchmark (32 questions) over the existing classicmodels database. expected_rows are intentionally null: they must be generated from the local database with experiment/generate_expected_rows.py (read-only), never typed by hand. The runner refuses to score a question whose expected_rows are missing or do not match the live reference query. Ids start at 101 so they never collide with the original gold set (ids 1-5), which is kept unchanged in gold_questions.json.

questions.question: List the first name and last name of every employee.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM employees;

questions.question: Show the last name of each employee together with the last name of the employee they report to, listing the employee's last name first and the manager's last name second. Include only employees who report to someone.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.lastName, m.lastName FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.reportsTo = m.employeeNumber;

questions.question: Show the order number, order date and shipped date of orders that have no shipped date recorded (the shipped date is empty).
questions.gold_sql: SELECT orderNumber, orderDate, shippedDate FROM orders WHERE shippedDate IS NULL;

questions.question: Show the product code, product name and buy price of products with a buy price above 100.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT productCode, productName, buyPrice FROM products WHERE buyPrice > 100;

questions.question: Show the order number, order date and status of orders that have the status 'Cancelled'.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT orderNumber, orderDate, status FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled';

questions.question: Show the customer name and credit limit of customers in the USA whose credit limit is greater than 100000.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customerName, creditLimit FROM customers WHERE country = 'USA' AND creditLimit > 100000;

questions.question: Show the customer number, payment date and amount of payments made in 2004 with an amount greater than 50000.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customerNumber, paymentDate, amount FROM payments WHERE paymentDate BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2004-12-31' AND amount > 50000;

questions.question: Show the first name and last name of employees whose job title is 'Sales Rep'.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM employees WHERE jobTitle = 'Sales Rep';

questions.question: Show each employee's first name, last name and the city of the office they work in.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode;

questions.question: Show the product name and the quantity ordered for every line of order number 10100.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.productName, od.quantityOrdered FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE od.orderNumber = 10100;

questions.question: Show the name of each customer that has an assigned sales representative, together with the first name and last name of that sales representative. Customers without a sales representative must not be listed.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, e.firstName, e.lastName FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber;

questions.question: List the distinct names of customers who have made at least one payment greater than 100000.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customerName FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE p.amount > 100000;

questions.question: For order number 10100, show the customer name, the product name and the quantity ordered for each order line.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, p.productName, od.quantityOrdered FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE o.orderNumber = 10100;

questions.question: How many customers are there in each country? Show the country and the number of customers.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country;

questions.question: List the names of customers who have ordered at least one product from the 'Planes' product line in any of their orders, regardless of order status. Show each customer name once.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber AND p.productLine = 'Planes');

questions.question: What is the total amount of all payments received?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments;

questions.question: Show the total sales value for each customer country, from highest to lowest. Sales value is the quantity ordered multiplied by the price each, summed over all order lines of all orders, including cancelled orders and orders of every other status. List only countries that have order lines. Show the country and the total.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY total DESC;

questions.question: What are the highest and the lowest MSRP among all products? Show the highest first and the lowest second.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(MSRP), MIN(MSRP) FROM products;

questions.question: How many employees work in each office city? Show the city and the number of employees.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT o.city, COUNT(e.employeeNumber) FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode GROUP BY o.city;

questions.question: How many different customers placed at least one order in 2004, based on the order date and regardless of order status?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customerNumber) FROM orders WHERE YEAR(orderDate) = 2004;

questions.question: Which customers placed more than 5 orders? Show the customer name and the number of orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName HAVING COUNT(o.orderNumber) > 5;

questions.question: Show the product name and buy price of products whose buy price is higher than the average buy price of all products.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT productName, buyPrice FROM products WHERE buyPrice > (SELECT AVG(buyPrice) FROM products);

questions.question: List the names of customers who have never placed an order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customerName FROM customers WHERE customerNumber NOT IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM orders);

questions.question: List the product codes and names of products that have never been ordered.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT productCode, productName FROM products WHERE productCode NOT IN (SELECT productCode FROM orderdetails);

questions.question: Show the product name and MSRP of the 5 products with the highest MSRP, highest first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT productName, MSRP FROM products ORDER BY MSRP DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: Show the customer number and amount of the 3 largest payments, largest first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customerNumber, amount FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3;

questions.question: List all product lines in alphabetical order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT productLine FROM productlines ORDER BY productLine;

questions.question: Which customer has paid the highest total amount? Show the customer name and the total amount paid.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Show the total sales value (quantity ordered times price each) for each product line, from highest to lowest, counting all orders regardless of their status. Show the product line and the total.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS total FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productLine ORDER BY total DESC;

questions.question: How many orders were placed in each year? Show the year and the number of orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(orderDate), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(orderDate);

questions.question: Show every customer's name with the number of orders they placed, including customers who placed no orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName;

questions.question: Show the customer name and country of customers whose name contains the word 'Gifts'.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customerName, country FROM customers WHERE customerName LIKE '%Gifts%';
